title: Kourovka Notebook Problem 21.38
exact_target: Does there exist a group where every nonidentity element has a generating partner, but some pair of nonidentity elements has no common generating partner?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2547 (KOU-21.38). CC BY 4.0.

S. Harper, C. Donoven and S. Corson, Problem 21.38, in E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (eds.), \emph{The Kourovka Notebook: Unsolved Problems in Group Theory}, 21st edition, arXiv:1401.0300v48 (6 October 2026). This version records an affirmative answer; the displayed question is the historically registered target.
